_comment: Consistency thresholds for Intel Arc Pro B60 (XPU). The GT images are CUDA-generated, and XPU seeds its initial latent noise from a different RNG stream, so pixels cannot match: the image is semantically identical (CLIP stays high) while ssim/psnr/mean_abs_diff degrade. Per-case entries below are only tuned where an XPU run has actually been measured; the rest are inherited from h100.json and will need the same treatment as they are triaged.

wan2_2_s2v_14b_2gpu._comment: S2V is gated by the two differential checks, not a golden. Regions are [w, h, x, y] for the 1280x704 frame rendered from the 16:9 portrait: audio_region is the mouth and jaw, static_region the defocused street the audio must not touch. Regions are frame geometry, so they carry across hardware; the bounds do not. Measured on 4x B60 (SP=4, 4 steps, 2026-10-12) over the three key frames with only the audio swapped: audio_region 27.52 dB mean (27.41/29.71/25.44), static_region 39.94 (37.71/46.81/35.31), separation 12.42 dB and 9.90 at its worst frame; the bound is half that. frame 0 vs the conditioning image measured 23.21/22.60 dB and ssim 0.825/0.810 at 4 steps, 21.41-22.30 and 0.78-0.80 at 40.
